ball.line: The friends are missing a ball for their game. Maybe we can bring it over later!

blocks.line: Building a tower together sounds fun. I bet Bruno would love to help!

chalk.line: We could draw something kind on the path for everyone to see.

tree.line: A cozy shady spot. Perfect for a quiet little rest.

friends.line: They're setting up a game. Soon there will be room for everyone!

gate.line: Beyond this gate there's a whole street to explore! Let's help our friends in the yard first — then we'll go for a walk together.

fountain.line: Ahh, fresh and cool! A little water break makes everything better.

locked.line: Let's say hi to Bruno first — he looks like he could use a friend.
